notes.title: Unknown Pleasures: our favourite new Steam releases
notes.content:
Welcome back to Unknown Pleasures, our weekly round-up of the most excellent hidden gems we dug up from the past week of new releases on Steam.

This week: botany simulation, electro-tanks, skeletal Wolverine and automatic Starship Troopers.
(more…)

notes.title: The Red Front Steam Store Launch!
notes.content:
Welcome everyone to the store launch for The Red Front.

You will be able to fight alongside your comrades from October 5th. Claim the Eastern Front and fight for the glory of The Red Army!

Post any questions you have, we will be sure to respond as soon as we can.
